detail: No line forces a Gmail connector call; MAILBOX bans it outright.

Residue: STEP 2 'search Gmail rfc822msgid:<that Message-ID>; one that returns this mail's Gmail id' maps to 'email_read original', which takes a provider id and cannot search by Message-ID (dead-ish fallback, wrong mapping).
'still in Gmail' (STEP 5) and 'open Gmail' (page body) are wording only.
Other ad@ output: STEP 6e delete_event notificationLevel ALL makes Google send cancellation notices from ad@'s calendar (decision 398 allows it; flag to Akshay).
MAIL AKSHAY FORWARDS: 'Every reply on such a mail, in any step, is a NEW mail from ad@thepodium.in' reads as licence for non-loop-in replies; ZOYA LIVE overrides, but reword.
STEP 3 replacement: 'His no: reply that we'd like to keep <original guest>' names no sender (falls to Zoya by ZOYA LIVE).
CONTEXT CHECK 'adapt it' vs the loop-in's 'exactly'.

Line 1 narrowed from 'replies in STEPS 6 to 6e' to 'loop-ins in STEPS 6 to 6b': STEP 6e's event cancel, STEP 5's draft delete and WhatsApp to Akshay are no longer in the 'you never act' exceptions (HARD RULES still allow them).

Daily cap: STEP 6 still says 'Within the daily cap' but the only definition (Activities starting 'Zoya sent', loop-ins excluded) was deleted with the Saurabh bullet. Loop-ins now log as 'Akshay to <name>: Zoya loop-in', so the count is undefined.
TOOLS 'No partial work' vs RUN RECORD's Partial and STEP 8 'carry on'; '(RUN RECORD still written)' is impossible when Notion is the missing tool.

Stakeholders 'read the whole chain with get_thread' on every touched thread vs STEP 1 'Read a message's THREAD only where a step needs the chain' (Stakeholders always needs it, so the cost is per touched thread).

THREAD tests References/In-Reply-To, but 'read each with action read' returns no headers (the prompt says so in STEP 2); every candidate needs 'original'. It also follows only ancestors and descendants, so sibling replies are missed unless you start at the root.
HOUSE COPIES fits the loop-in (Zoya in Cc); Chaandini on vendor mail to a B2S alias is unclear.
STEP 3 repeat pitch gets 'the usual holding reply (STEP 6a, "thanks <first name>, adding @Zoya ...")' vs STEP 6 'Skip repeat pitches (STEP 3)'; 6a is now the Saurabh step (pre-existing, now worse).

defects: D1 MAILBOX gives only the reply form for a loop-in ('email_compose action reply on that message ... To its sender'). There is no recipe for STEP 6/6a/6b's NEW mail (Saurabh-only or Akshay-forwarded pitch): action send, to original sender, explicit cc, subject 'Re: <original>'. Read literally, it replies to Saurabh.
D2 STEP 7 RSVP search uses subject 'invitation'. RSVP subjects lack it, so nothing gets archived (I7).

D3 Read window misses mail outside INBOX/Sent: on IMAP, include_folders ['inbox','sent'] skips archived mail and filtered labels. The old Gmail search covered all mail. Mail Akshay archives before the hourly run is never logged. Add the archive (All Mail) folder and dedupe by Message-ID.

D4 'read to' = newest message read, even if a later step failed on an older one. A message whose Activity create (or loop-in) failed falls behind T after 30 min and is never retried. The uncommitted worktree script fixes logging only.

D5 STEPS 6, 6a, 6b, 6d and 6e still say 'in the last 72 hours' / 'every inbox thread from the last 72 hours' while STEP 1 reads about an hour. Reading 1: a separate 72h search every run brings back the re-read load that blew the quota. Reading 2: only this run's messages, so a failed send is never retried. Pick one and say it.
D6 Daily cap reference left dangling (STEP 6).
D7 THREAD needs headers that action read does not return. It also misses sibling branches.
D8 'read to' lives only in the record's page body. Finding 'the newest inbox run record that has one' means fetching bodies one by one (this run's own Started row first). Put it in the Summary.
D9 STEP 5 draft delete: no way to map a Gmail draft id to an MCP draft_id (draft_list plus a match rule needed).
D10 Loop-in Activity 'Source ID the sent message id' should say msgid:<sent Message-ID>. Gmail-over-IMAP may also file a second Sent copy.
D11 Line 1 exception list narrowed (see c).
